name: binhex-filebrowser-quantum
description: File Browser provides a file managing interface within a specified directory and it can be used to upload, delete, preview and edit your files. It is a create-your-own-cloud-kind of software where you can just install it on your server, direct it to a path and access your files through a nice web interface.

paths.name: Path: /config
paths.description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

paths.name: Path: /media
paths.description: This is the container path to your media files, e.g. movies, tv, music, pictures etc.

ports.name: Port: Web Interface
ports.description: This is the Web UI port for the application.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Admin password. Leave blank to keep the upstream behaviour: a random admin password is generated, written to /config/filebrowser/logs/filebrowser.log once, and a reset is forced at first login.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_JWT_TOKEN_SECRET
variables.description: Secret used to sign JWT authentication tokens. Changing it after first start invalidates all existing sessions.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_TOTP_SECRET
variables.description: Encryption secret for stored TOTP two-factor secrets. Set it before enrolling users in TOTP.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_RECAPTCHA_SECRET
variables.description: reCAPTCHA secret key used by password authentication when reCAPTCHA is enabled in config.yaml.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_LDAP_USER_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password of the LDAP bind account used to look up users.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: OIDC client id for single sign-on, for example from Authentik, Keycloak or Pocket ID.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: OIDC client secret for single sign-on.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_ONLYOFFICE_SECRET
variables.description: JWT secret shared with your OnlyOffice document server.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_DISABLE_AUTOMATIC_BACKUP
variables.description: Automatic backups are on by default. Set this to true to disable the backup taken automatically before an upgrade.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_CONFIG
variables.description: Path to the configuration file. The default config is seeded here on first start when the file is absent.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_DATABASE_PATH
variables.description: Path to the SQLite database.

variables.name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_FFMPEG_PATH
variables.description: Directory holding the ffmpeg and ffprobe binaries.

variables.name: Variable: ADDITIONAL_PARAMETERS
variables.description: Additional parameters to pass to the File Browser cli

variables.name: Variable: ENABLE_HEALTHCHECK
variables.description: Enable or disable healthchecks.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
variables.description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
variables.description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
variables.description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

variables.name: Variable: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the running container

variables.name: Variable: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the running container

variables.name: Variable: UMASK
variables.description: UMASK for the running container
